pr_title: Setting Show the thumbnails for media files
pr_body:
Add new setting "Show the thumbnails for media files".
When the settings is disabled, the media files show the file type icon.
Closes #6421 #8234 #8257 #8305

**Validation**
How did you test these changes?
- [ ] Built and ran the app
- [ ] Tested the changes for accessibility

**Screenshots (optional)**
![ShowThumbnails1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/46631671/162562081-ebacba81-6c5a-4e49-90e0-039867e9c6c5.png)
![ShowThumbnails2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/46631671/162562083-fb981909-76c3-4d4f-b03e-718f589e9e45.png)
![ShowThumbnails3](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/46631671/162562086-e322aa55-a93d-490b-9e86-09767a20a57c.png)
pr_comments: @cinqmilleans does this work for other file types or is it only for media files?

@yaichenbaum There are currently 3 icon levels
- If the file is an image or a video, a thumbnail is generated to replace the icon. Other files may have them in the future: pdf, word, url, mp3 (cover) ... But they are always media (document, web, audio ...). If the file is not media, we can't generate a thumbnail, it doesn't make sense.
- If the file contains an icon, it is used (.exe).
- Otherwise, the file type icon.

This pr just disables thumbnails. This does not impact .exes. This pr therefore only concerns the media.
@cinqmilleans I don't usually think of pdf files as media files. Would it be possible to change the wording to "Always show icons"?

@yaichenbaum PDFs are not currently affected. For now, and probably forever, we only have thumbnails for images and videos. I suggest the text "Show thumbnails for images and videos" (enabled by default). We will change the text later as needed if we add more types.

> @yaichenbaum PDFs are not currently affected. For now, and probably forever, we only have thumbnails for images and videos. I suggest the text "Show thumbnails for images and videos" (enabled by default). We will change the text later as needed if we add more types.

It depends on the file handler but there are multiple file types which support thumbnails, I think it's best to use generic words that aren't specific to the file type.

issue_context.title: Add an option to always show icons, never thumbnails
issue_context.body:
### What's the Problem?

I strongly prefer the option to always show only icons of all files instead of thumbnails, no matter which layout I deem fit for any folder. Unfortunately, I do not believe there is such an option currently in Files and I did not find a previous issue regarding this matter.

### Solution/Idea

Add an option to always show icons instead of thumbnails.

### Alternatives

None.

### Priorities

_No response_

### Files Version

2.0.13.0

### Windows Version

10.0.19044.1237

### Additional comment

_No response_
comments: Actually, "Files" is trying to offer improvements in displaying thumbnails, though taking more control of your explorer should also be part of the app, I guess it would be normal to include what is already part of usual features of the classic windows file explorer.

Completely agree. I use a few network drives and Files is churning through every single folder to try to create thumbnails. First thing I did was comb the settings for the option to not show thumbnails, and it's sorely missing for me.
This issue should be resolved with #8888

review_comments: Since it's a privacy feature I'm not sure if it needs to be logged. Need second opinion from @yaichenbaum
AppCenter doesn't track any personal data, so this is fine.
